problem: A confirmed legacy reference gap: a pre-CR-15 canonical Experience's bare-filename evidence_source was treated as repo-root-relative by retrieveCanonicalHistoryByProblem, so a correct literal-phrase match still failed the whole call with ok:false/INVALID_SOURCE instead of resolving or gracefully reporting that one reference as unresolved.

decision.decision_summary: Add one narrow, general fallback: a bare (path-separator-free) reference is additionally tried under CANONICAL_HISTORY_DOCUMENT_DIRECTORY, the one directory already established as the canonical Experience/History document home; accepted only when uniquely resolved and SHA-consistent. Any unresolved, ambiguous, or SHA-mismatched legacy reference fails closed for that one History node only, never for the whole call, and never contaminates a sibling reference that does resolve. References that already carry a path keep their prior strict, hard-failing contract unchanged. No historical Experience file, index, store, schema, or semantic/vector/RAG mechanism was added.

action.action_summary: Extended the existing genieCanonicalLearningRetrieval.mjs and its existing verifier; added one positive fixture, three negative fixtures (missing, ambiguous, wrong-SHA), one mixed no-contamination fixture, and re-verified the real Incident A case live against the repository; ran all existing GENIE regressions.

evidence.evidence_detail: Incident A live-reverified OK with sha256 18ca34ba022e60af3d3c3326483fca59972d25a88837212b6db7905eac87a8db via CANONICAL_HISTORY_DIRECTORY_FALLBACK; missing/ambiguous/wrong-SHA negative controls and a mixed-sibling no-contamination control all pass; fixture checks 37->43; 11/11 GENIE regressions passed; zero bytes changed on disk during the run.

cause.root_cause_summary: A bare (directory-free) legacy evidence_source value predating the CR-15 evidence-reference convention was resolved only against the repository root; since it never lived there, the read threw and the exception propagated past the function's own try/catch, failing the entire call rather than the one reference.

lesson: A single unresolved legacy reference should fail closed for itself, not for the whole retrieval: try one additional, already-established real location (never repo-root by blind assumption), accept only a unique SHA-consistent match, and report anything else (missing, ambiguous, wrong-SHA) as an explicit unresolved node instead of throwing or guessing.
